Section 01 · Identity
Who is the athlete?
Name is required.

If you want this athlete to log into STRIDE OS themselves (to log their own workouts or connect Strava), enter their email. You can send them an invite from the roster after saving.

Section 02 · Training
Training background
Section 03 · Events
Race events
Primary event is required.

Section 04 · Primary Race Result
Source performance *
Distance is required.
Enter a valid time (e.g. 2:18.4).
Accepts City, State or ZIP for precise weather pinpointing. ZIP gets the most accurate readings.
Enables hour-specific weather. Leave blank for daily summary.
Climate-controlled — outdoor weather for this date won't be fetched or applied (a January indoor PR shouldn't get a 20°F correction).
Section 05 · Additional PRs (Optional)
Other event times

Logging multiple race times reveals where the athlete is strong, weak, or balanced. This powers the Multi-Event Analysis tab. Leave blank if no recent result for that distance. Add the date each mark was set when you know it — marks from the last 90 days steer the consensus curve hardest; a four-year-old PR stays on the chart with much-reduced influence (×0.3).
